definitions.major: English verdict carries a defect with severity "major"
definitions.ocr_bad: the translation judge, with the image, set ocr_misread or ocr_wrong_leaf
definitions.bad_7866: #7866 grade search_only or worse (a reading that changes the sense, or worse)
definitions.inherited: major English defect on a page whose #7866 grade is bad_7866

agreement.note: a = this judge (translation audit, image addendum); b = #7866 transcription grade. Two different instruments with different bars: #7866 tags any sense-changing reading (misleads) on a full read of the page; the addendum asks only for a misreading visible at this resolution, and to leave it false when unsure.

inherited.attributable_note: AF = P(bad_7866 | major) x (1 - P(major | not bad_7866) / P(major | bad_7866)): the share of major-defect pages the bad transcription accounts for, once the rate at which the English fails on a good transcription is subtracted. Observational: books with bad transcriptions also differ in language and hand.
